_note: HARD candidate set for μ−Zσ gate calibration: confusable neighbor pairs (must pick the right target), value-change-vs-contradiction boundaries (stale value → UPDATE; explicit negation of the old fact → INVALIDATE), narrower-vs-refining boundaries (covered → NOOP; adds a real condition → UPDATE), cross-lingual duplicates. Built to produce variance the clean set can't.

candidates.text: HTTP client timeout was raised from 30 to 60 seconds.
We found 15-minute JWT expiry too aggressive and moved to 60-minute access tokens.
API retries stay at 3 attempts with backoff, but now only for idempotent (GET/PUT) requests.
Deploys are no longer manual — a GitHub Actions pipeline deploys automatically on merge.
Deploys now go straight to production; the staging step was removed.
Local development now uses Postgres in Docker; SQLite was dropped entirely.
JS packages are installed with pnpm.
Python-зависимости ставим только через uv, pip не используем.
API calls to the payments service retry with exponential backoff.
We branch off main for feature work.
Database schema migrations run through Alembic.
